findings.issue_summary: Confirm Play Console declaration for the dataSync foreground service used by automatic backups.
findings.evidence: data/backup/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:5-13 requests foreground service permissions and correctly declares SystemForegroundService with dataSync. BackupForegroundNotification.kt:14-45 creates a visible notification and matches the dataSync type. AutomaticBackupRunner.kt:47-49 requires enabled automatic backup and an authorized account before upload.
findings.recommendation: Complete or verify the dataSync foreground service declaration in Play Console for the release. No missing service type or notification defect was observed.
